explication: This is a Rust MCP server that exposes Elasticsearch capabilities to AI clients over stdio or streamable HTTP. The main workflow is client request → selected transport → Elasticsearch MCP service → Elasticsearch request → tool result. The implementation also parses configuration, expands environment variables, and supports configured tools and prompts. The README documents both transports and health checks. Some server registration details and custom-tool behavior are in unsampled portions, so those links are omitted or marked unverified rather than inferred.
